equipment.name: Helium ion microscope (HIM)
equipment.specifications: Allows structuring nanoscale materials on a lengthscale of sub-10 nm or down to the single defect level

equipment.name: Focused ion beam (FIB)
equipment.specifications: Utilizes Ga+-ions to locally sputter materials into nanoscale circuits and fabricate thin lamellas

equipment.name: Atomic layer deposition (ALD)
equipment.specifications: Thin-film deposition technique based on the sequential use of a gas phase chemical process

equipment.name: Atomic force microscope (AFM)
equipment.specifications: Allows characterizing the surface of nanoscale materials with a resolution close to the atomic limit

equipment.name: XPS/UPS
equipment.specifications: Ultraviolet and x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy relying on photoemission of electrons from thin surface layers
